sensory_details_i_remember: I remember the flicker of fluorescent lights above the anxious faces of students
I noticed the pungent scent of antiseptic wafting through the air, mingling with the sweat of nervous students
I felt the vibration of hushed conversations and frantic typing on laptops beneath the tense silence
I recall the sight of crumpled resumes and empty caffeine-stained mugs littering the benches
